source.title: Scramble set from the finished group was re-used
source.content:
After the competition, a competitor reported that they had both the scrambles from the previous group and from their (current) group in their average. The competitor was also a scrambler for the previous group. The WCA Delegate also confirmed they could have left two consecutive scramble sets open at the same time. 

Since the scramble secrecy was violated, the WRC agreed that **the results from the affected round should be removed** (also resulting in the removal of the final round).

translation.title: 已结束组别的打乱组被重复使用
translation.content:
赛后，一名选手报告自己的平均中既有前一组打乱，也有本组打乱。该选手还是前一组的打乱员。代表也确认，自己可能同时打开了相邻两组打乱。

由于打乱保密性遭到破坏，WRC 同意**删除受影响轮次的成绩**，同时也删除了决赛轮次。
